facts.fact: Barbados has a population of about 300,000 people, according to the page.
facts.quote: Barbados is the easternmost Caribbean island — 300,000 people, English-speaking, and one of the Caribbean's most prosperous nations.

facts.fact: The Barbados Dollar is permanently pegged at BBD 2 = USD 1, according to the page.
facts.quote: Barbados uses the Barbados Dollar (BBD) which is permanently pegged at BBD 2 = USD 1

facts.fact: The page states that Barbados became a republic in 2021 while remaining in the Commonwealth.
facts.quote: The island became a republic in 2021 while remaining in the Commonwealth.
